notes: Fake Your Own Death, printed: 'return it to the battlefield tapped under its OWNER's control and YOU create a Treasure token.' Seat 0 steals seat 1's 2/2 (control until the game ends, as Mind Control does), then casts the spell on it. Seat 1's Pinger kills it with 2 damage. It returns tapped under its OWNER's control (seat 1), but 'you' is the controller of the ability, seat 0, who controlled the creature when it died: seat 0 gets the Treasure. Proof: seat 0 (no lands, no mana left) casts Unsummon at the Pinger by tapping the Treasure.
